name: overleaf-web-mcp
description: Read, edit, compile, and review your Overleaf projects through your own signed-in web session.
long_description: An unofficial MCP server for Overleaf, not affiliated with Overleaf. It works through your own Overleaf web session: once installed, ask Claude to sign you in, and a browser window opens for you to sign in as usual. It reaches the projects your account can open, on overleaf.com or a self-hosted Overleaf. Every edit is checked against the revision it was read at, tracked changes are supported, and destructive tools ask for an explicit confirmation value.

base_url.title: Overleaf address
base_url.description: The Overleaf server to use. Change it only for a self-hosted Overleaf, and sign in to that address.

allowed_projects.title: Allowed project ids
allowed_projects.description: Comma-separated project ids the server may open. Leave it empty to allow every project your account can open.

browser_path.title: Browser for signing in
browser_path.description: Full path to Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, or Microsoft Edge, used to open the Overleaf sign-in window. Leave it empty to find one automatically.
